owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

UniswapFeesCollected().notice: Cumulative WETH-notional LP fees recorded by the strategy (drives vault fee-per-share accounting).

harvestBoolean(bool).notice: Harvest / compound fees. Same allowlist as `onlyAuthorized`, plus self-call from `beforeDeposit`.

mintNewPosition().notice: Drain LP (if any) and remint current ASSET with current band params (`rangeBelowTicks` / `rangeAboveTicks`).

protocolFeeBps().notice: Share of collected Uniswap LP fees sent to `feeManager` (1000 = 10%).

reserveBps().notice: Share of post-protocol deposit/fee capital kept idle as reserve (both legs). Default 4000 = 40%.
